label: Run 9 · all 3 chats
note: Every chat of run 9 (run 7's profiles; the brief cut to its what and why; one joke, one punchline): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer.

chat.variety.why: All three chats run the same beats in the same order. Reuben opens with a deflecting bit signed "Yours in ___". Brick answers by quoting one word back ("Rains." / "Loft." / "Sometime.") and then lists his own body first. Next come the mirrored cropped-family-photo backstories, then Marguerite's calendar and Delphine's "normal voice", then the paired wants (Reuben gagged and described "in the present tense"; Brick timestamps followed by talk "until I forget the time"), and every chat closes on a timestamped booking. Many lines recur across all three, not just two: "oh — okay", the dishwasher-safe tattoo, "present tense", "normal voice" and the cousin crop. Others recur in two: "scheduled being loved", boxed rosé, "thirty-eight, not thirty-one" and "ten quiet minutes". It rises above a 1 only because the endings differ in emphasis: Booster's Reuben slides back into a bit ("or whenever you're free, no rush"), Wong's Brick sets the schedule, and Carr's Brick redefines intimacy as the hand on the back.
chat.variety.raise: Give at least one chat a different opening move and turning point, for example Brick opening, or the backstory coming out through a fight instead of a mutual confession, and cut the shared stock lines ("oh — okay", dishwasher-safe, "present tense", "until I forget the time") so none appears in more than two chats.
